pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal regions with soft, diffused edge gradients. Patches exhibit a desaturated tan hue, with individual geometries showing rounded vertices and varying spatial areas that diminish in size toward the posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Broad, cream-colored topological pathways forming a continuous grid. Junction nodes are wide and frequent, with the pixel thickness of the light-colored pathways being high relative to the patch surface area on the lower neck and mid-section.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A short, dense mane with a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated profile along the dorsal ridge of the neck and upper shoulder. The silhouette exhibits a uniform, brush-like texture.
